definitions.explanation: A clear Japanese soup made with dashi and typically containing a few refined ingredients. Distinguished from miso soup by its clear, delicate broth.

examples.japanese: {吸|す}い{物|もの}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
{吸|す}い{物|もの}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{味噌汁|みそしる}→味噌汁：04954_misoshiru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{違|ちが}う→違う：01957_chigau⟧⟦{味|あじ}→味：00826_aji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Clear soup has a different taste from miso soup.

examples.japanese: {吸|す}い{物|もの}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{出汁|だし}→出汁：04917_dashi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{透|す}き{通|とお}っています→透き通る：14316_sukitooru⟧。
examples.english: The broth of clear soup is transparent.

examples.japanese: {吸|す}い{物|もの}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{味噌汁|みそしる}→味噌汁：04954_misoshiru⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{上品|じょうひん}→上品：03081_jouhin⟧な⟦{味|あじ}→味：00826_aji⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{正式|せいしき}→正式：03376_seishiki⟧な⟦{和食|わしょく}→和食：10436_washoku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{合|あ}います→合う：10466_au⟧。
examples.english: Clear soup has a more refined taste than miso soup and suits formal Japanese cuisine.

examples.japanese: ⟦{松茸|まつたけ}→松茸：13119_matsutake⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{吸|す}い{物|もの}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{秋|あき}→秋：02276_aki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{贅沢|ぜいたく}→贅沢：03309_zeitaku⟧な⟦{一品|いっぴん}→一品：08919_ippin⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{香|かお}り→香り：00189_kaori⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧⟦{豊|ゆた}か→豊か：03654_yutaka⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: Matsutake mushroom clear soup is a luxurious autumn dish with a very rich aroma.

notes:
Usually said with the polite prefix お: お{吸|す}い{物|もの}. A few chosen ingredients (tofu, shrimp, clams, seasonal vegetables) float in clear dashi seasoned with salt and a little soy sauce, topped with a fragrant garnish (⟦{吸|す}い{口|くち}→吸い口：30944_suikuchi⟧) such as ⟦{木|き}の{芽|め}→木の芽：30945_kinome⟧ or yuzu peel.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{味噌汁|みそしる}→味噌汁：04954_misoshiru⟧: miso soup — everyday and cloudy with miso; {吸|す}い{物|もの} is clear and more formal
- すまし{汁|じる}: another name for clear soup

CULTURAL NOTE:
Clam soup ({蛤|はまぐり}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{吸|す}い{物|もの}) is traditional for the Girls' Festival (⟦ひな{祭|まつ}り→ひな祭り：10517_hinamatsuri⟧), and matsutake soup is an autumn luxury.
